'''Royd Pew''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked in the [[Tech (Imperial Intelligence)|Tech Section]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. He was in charge of creating and modifying technology for field agents.

==History==
[[Jahan Cross]] visited him before his trip to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] to arm himself. While there, he and Pew observed [[Bleeker]] test out a set of [[Parawings/Legends|parawings]]. Even though the test was unsuccessful, Cross still decided to take a set with him. Pew expressed disbelief at this decision, but then went with Cross to look at weapons for his trip.

==Personality and traits==
Royd Pew was a short, balding man with thick spectacles that hid his eyes. He exhibited [[Speciesism]] by expressing his disdain for [[Alessi Quon]].
